choose.when: SELECT id,source_id,name AS subject_name,status AS raw_status,created_at,updated_at,started_at,finished_at FROM lx_download_batch WHERE id=#{businessId}

SELECT t.id,t.source_id,s.name AS subject_name,t.status AS raw_status,t.phase AS stage, t.directories,t.entries,t.total_songs,t.matched_songs,t.review_songs,t.skipped_files, t.added_songs,t.reused_songs,t.missing_songs,t.removed_songs,t.cancel_requested,t.error, t.created_at,t.started_at,t.finished_at FROM media_scan_task t LEFT JOIN media_source s ON s.id=t.source_id WHERE t.id=#{businessId}
SELECT id,status AS raw_status,mode,skipped_existing,created_at,updated_at FROM metadata_batch WHERE id=#{businessId}
SELECT id,status AS raw_status,created_at,updated_at FROM classification_task WHERE id=#{businessId}
SELECT id,state AS raw_status,selection_total,prepared_count,preparation_error AS error,created_at,updated_at FROM audio_batch WHERE id=#{businessId}

SELECT j.id,j.song_id,j.kind,j.state AS raw_status,j.result_json,j.error,j.created_at,j.updated_at, s.result_json AS song_json,s.source_id,src.name AS source_name, (SELECT MIN(batch_id) FROM audio_batch_item WHERE job_id=j.id) AS parent_business_id, CASE WHEN j.kind='PROBE' AND j.node_origin='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tracked FROM media_audio_job j LEFT JOIN media_song s ON s.id=j.song_id LEFT JOIN media_source src ON src.id=s.source_id WHERE j.id=#{businessId}

SELECT t.id,t.song_id,t.state AS raw_status,t.result_json,t.error,t.created_at,t.updated_at, s.result_json AS song_json,s.source_id,src.name AS source_name FROM media_transcode t LEFT JOIN media_song s ON s.id=t.song_id LEFT JOIN media_source src ON src.id=s.source_id WHERE t.id=#{businessId} AND t.purpose='OFFLINE'
SELECT id,mode,state AS raw_status,result_json,created_at,updated_at FROM song_cache_cleanup_job WHERE id=#{businessId}

choose.when: SELECT i.id,i.song_id,i.track_json,i.status,i.message,CAST(i.updated_at AS CHAR) AS source_updated_at FROM lx_download_item i LEFT JOIN background_task_item b ON b.task_id=#{taskId} AND b.id=i.id WHERE i.batch_id=#{businessId} AND i.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 200

SELECT i.id,i.song_id,i.title,i.status,i.error_message AS message,CAST(i.updated_at AS CHAR) AS source_updated_at FROM metadata_item i LEFT JOIN background_task_item b ON b.task_id=#{taskId} AND b.id=i.id WHERE i.batch_id=#{businessId} AND i.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 200

SELECT i.id,i.song_id,i.input_json,i.status,i.error AS message,CAST(i.updated_at AS CHAR) AS source_updated_at FROM classification_item i LEFT JOIN background_task_item b ON b.task_id=#{taskId} AND b.id=i.id WHERE i.task_id=#{businessId} AND i.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 200

SELECT i.song_id AS id,i.song_id,i.title,i.state AS status,i.error AS message, CAST(i.updated_at AS CHAR) AS source_updated_at,j.result_json AS execution,j.kind, COALESCE(j.updated_at,0) AS execution_updated_at,j.id AS job_id,j.state AS job_state FROM audio_batch_item i LEFT JOIN media_audio_job j ON j.id=i.job_id LEFT JOIN background_task_item b ON b.task_id=#{taskId} AND b.id=i.song_id WHERE i.batch_id=#{businessId} AND i.song_id > #{cursor} AND (b.id IS NULL OR b.status <> i.state OR b.source_updated_at <> CAST(i.updated_at AS CHAR) OR b.execution_updated_at <> COALESCE(j.updated_at,0)) ORDER BY i.song_id LIMIT 200
